title: Tessellate Resource Preview
visibleText:
✦
How can Tessellate assist your build?

Tessellate composes validated interface systems from canonical resources. Select a starter prompt below to begin:

Compose B2B SaaS Dashboard
Create an analytics dashboard with KPI delta card, time series line chart, and audit log block.
Audit Color Contrast
Validate WCAG 2.2 AA token compliance across Quiet, Expressive, and Nocturne presets.
Export Standalone Vite App
Export workspace to a pure Vite + React + Tailwind 4 source tree.
